findings.check: NEAR inflows to the 3 revenue wallets (NearBlocks) at daily prices vs DefiLlama holders revenue, since the fee switch; holds if within ±2%

findings.finding: NEAR's own dashboard agrees on the wallets
findings.check: all-time NEAR received by the same 3 wallets vs revenue.near.org's wallet table; holds if within ±1%

findings.finding: Buybacks offset well under a fifth of issuance
findings.check: NEAR captured / net issuance from archival-RPC total supply, Feb–Oct 2026; holds if both definitions are below 20%

findings.finding: Market cap is far above break-even
findings.number: 197x annual captured revenue vs 41x (64x after HSP-029)
findings.check: identity: supply stops growing iff market cap / annual captured revenue < 1 / issuance; holds if above the post-cut threshold

findings.finding: NEAR's take doubled from August to October
findings.number: 2.2 → 5.5 bps of volume (1.8x to 2.5x depending on the window: make robustness)
findings.check: wallet revenue / NEAR-reported Intents volume, by month; holds if October ≥ 2× August

findings.finding: Confidential swaps pay NEAR more than public ones, in every method
findings.check: weekly fit in levels and in first differences, Aug–Oct; holds if the confidential coefficient exceeds the public one in both

findings.finding: They explain part, not all, of the jump
findings.check: (change in confidential share) × (confidential premium) / rise in take, under three premiums; holds if the range spans below 100%

findings.finding: Drop 1 of NEAR@3.33 cost less than the revenue uplift
findings.check: 333,333 NEAR at the conversion price vs Sep–Oct revenue above the May–Aug take rate; holds if cost < uplift

findings.finding: The fit missed its first unseen week
findings.check: week of 2026-11-02, never used in the fit; holds (as a reported failure) if actual < both predictions

findings.finding: Confidential TVL did not leave after the snapshot (H4.1 rejected)
findings.check: Dune confidential TVL around the NEAR@3.33 snapshot, then NEAR's dashboard; holds if TVL 30 days later > at the snapshot

findings.finding: Supply still grows through 2027 in the base case
findings.number: median 19% of 2027 issuance offset (6% chance of a deflationary 2027)
findings.check: Monte Carlo, 10,000 paths, joint block bootstrap of volume and price; holds if the median is below 100% with and without HSP-029

findings.finding: Peers are priced on their revenue, NEAR is not
findings.check: market cap / annualised holders revenue (DefiLlama, CoinGecko); holds if NEAR is above every peer's interquartile range

findings.finding: Usage does not lead NEAR's price (the track's hypothesis)
findings.number: 0 of 24 lead-lag tests significant after Holm; best r = +0.15, p = 0.15 before correction (L1 transactions, 1-week lag)
findings.check: weekly changes, NEAR price net of BTC, lags 1–4 weeks, Intents volume and L1 activity, both directions; holds if none is significant at 5% after Holm

findings.finding: NEAR's BigQuery dataset agrees with the pipeline's sources
findings.number: revenue wallets 3.292M NEAR on both, max monthly gap 0 (identical to the last digit); net issuance Feb–Oct 23.87M (0.06% apart)
findings.check: queries in sql/ run on NEAR's public BigQuery dataset vs NearBlocks wallet histories and archival-RPC supply; holds if every month is within 0.1% and issuance within 0.5%

findings.finding: The 1Click results recompute without the partner key
findings.number: 30 figures (integrator shares, the November take, the fee-schedule test) recomputed from the published daily aggregates, all within 1.5%
findings.check: data/processed/oneclick_daily.csv (daily sums by integrator, route type, NEAR fee tier, ZEC; no swap or address) recomputed and compared with the outputs of make swaps; holds if all agree within 1.5%

findings.finding: The rebuilt revenue never revises; the aggregators' latest days do
findings.number: 0 of 1,436 daily readings of the rebuilt revenue changed across 6 dated snapshots; DefiLlama's gross fees for the latest day were revised up to ×185 (2026-11-10: $1,611 → $297,452), settled after 3 days
findings.check: every dated snapshot in data/raw compared day by day with the latest (same rebuild code on each wallet snapshot); holds if no complete day of the rebuilt revenue moved by 1% or more (figures that use DefiLlama's gross fees stop at its settled days)

findings.finding: The exploit cost NEAR little revenue, but large integrators pulled back
findings.number: 1Click stopped for 3.7 hours on 1 Oct (08:33 to 12:16 UTC), about $2,014 of NEAR revenue; in the two weeks after, NEAR's 1Click revenue changed −13% (inside the range of 21 placebo dates) while the 25 largest integrators' volume changed −39%, below every placebo date (−18% at worst); 3 of the 10 that cut back returned by November
findings.check: 1Click swap aggregates: the longest gap with no swap on 1 Oct; the median day of 3-16 Oct against 15-28 Sep, ranked against the same split at every date whose windows avoid 27 Sep-4 Oct; holds if the halt lasted under 12 hours, NEAR's 1Click revenue change lies within the placebo range and the top-25 integrators' volume change lies below it

findings.finding: Users pay about 60 bps a swap on 1Click; NEAR keeps about a sixteenth of it
findings.number: 59 bps of what users send is gone on delivery (2026-10-14 to 2026-11-12, 507,526 swaps): integrators 43, NEAR 3.8, solvers and networks 12 (6.4% to NEAR)
findings.check: dollar value sent and delivered per 1Click swap (Explorer API), split by the fees in each record, daily sums committed; holds if NEAR's share of the user's cost is under 10% and integrators' over half

findings.finding: The buyback wallet's balance is explained by its receipts, to a fraction of a NEAR
findings.number: 2,281,071.88 NEAR rebuilt from 3,408 receipts vs 2,281,071.57 read on-chain at block 224,504,334 (gap −0.31 NEAR)
findings.check: every NEAR in minus every NEAR out of buybacks.multisignature.near since its creation (committed history), against the archival-RPC balance at the block after the last receipt; holds if within 1 NEAR
